usedFor: Canny collects feedback, and each “New Post Created” becomes a log entry in Google Sheets.

bestTemplate.name: “New Post Created” in Canny, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each new feedback post lands as a spreadsheet row, ready to sort and review.

watchOut: “Delete Rows” is also available in Google Sheets and removes data, so pick it only for cleanup.
